text: I'm so sorry to be messaging this late, I know you must be very busy and it's probably nothing. I'm looking after my granddaughter tonight, she's 6. She started with a bit of a cough yesterday, only a small one, and this evening she felt hot so I took her temperature and it's 39.2. Her mum's away until tomorrow and I didn't want to ring her and worry her. She's been to the toilet fine, weeing normally, so I don't think she's short of fluids. I suppose I just wanted someone to tell me whether 39.2 is too high or whether I'm fussing like I always do. Thank you, and sorry again.
